remarks: Lovely Updated Townhome - Light-Filled & Modern Living Step into this beautifully updated townhome featuring a bright, airy layout and amazing finishes throughout. The spacious living room welcomes you with a charming Juliet balcony and cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Enjoy meals in the separate dining area just off the modern kitchen, which boasts granite countertops, granite island, stainless steel appliances, and a pantry for extra storage. Updated powder room is perfect for guests. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms and an updated bathroom with stylish fixtures. The convenience of in-unit laundry adds to the ease of everyday living. Included is one designated parking space, with additional street parking available. Ideally located close to Metro, major highways, and shopping-this move-in-ready home combines comfort, style, and unbeatable convenience.
